prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: transparent decorative annotation for the Byggkollektivet architectural portfolio
Primary request: Create one playful hand-drawn watering can doodle with a short loose arc of water droplets, matching the bold painted-marker energy of the supplied cobalt chair reference.
Input images: Image 1 is the style, stroke, transparency, and cobalt-color reference only.
Subject: a simple slightly wonky metal watering can in three-quarter side view, recognizable handle, long spout, and five or six casual droplets; charming and energetic rather than cute or cartoon-faced.
Style/medium: saturated cobalt-blue paint marker or wax crayon, visibly hand-drawn with uneven edges, overlapping strokes, and imperfect proportions.
Composition/framing: landscape canvas; watering can occupies the central two-thirds with generous transparent space; droplets extend toward one upper corner.
Color palette: one saturated cobalt blue only.
Constraints: genuinely transparent background; no typography, face, photograph, garden scene, ground, shadows, border, watermark, or extra objects. Preserve the rough physical painted quality of the reference.
